ext_lede: Server modules, payment gateways, addons and themes for PNLCS, built by the companies that use it. Each listing links to its publisher, where you buy it, download it and get support.
ext_search_placeholder: Search by name, feature or publisher
ext_no_results_d: Try fewer filters or another search word.
ext_empty: Nothing is listed yet. Yours can be the first.
ext_notice_body: These modules and themes are built and sold by companies that use PNLCS, not by the PNLCS team. A maintainer checks that a listing's details are complete before it goes up, but the PNLCS team does not test or support the code itself. Prices, licences and support are set by each publisher, and pnlcs.com takes no part in any sale.
ext_notice_check: Read the code or ask the publisher before you install anything on a live system.
ext_official: Looking for what ships with PNLCS?
ext_add_lede: The list is a file in this website's repository. Free or paid, open or closed source: anything built for PNLCS can be listed. Sales happen on your own website.
ext_add_step1: Open the list file on GitHub
ext_add_step1_d: The button opens it in the editor. GitHub makes a copy in your account the first time.
ext_add_step2_d: Name, summary, description, features, price type, licence, the PNLCS version it works with, screenshots and the page where people get it.
ext_add_step3_d: An automatic check builds the site with your entry. A maintainer reviews it and merges.
ext_sold_by: Sold and supported by {publisher}. pnlcs.com takes no part in the sale.
ext_in_english: Listings are written by their publishers, in English.
ext_report: Report a problem with this listing
